headers.//: Security headers for everything Vercel serves STATICALLY. The routes rewritten to api/index.js get these from helmet in src/server/app.js; the SPA never reaches Express, so without this block the most-visited page on the site was the only one shipping no CSP, no nosniff and no frame protection. The negative lookahead excludes the function-backed paths so a response can never carry two conflicting copies of the same header. Keep the CSP string below identical to the production directives in src/server/app.js — they describe one policy and drift between them is invisible until something breaks.

headers.value: default-src 'self';style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';script-src 'self';img-src 'self' data: https:;connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co;font-src 'self' https: data:;base-uri 'self';form-action 'self';frame-ancestors 'self';object-src 'none';script-src-attr 'none';upgrade-insecure-requests

headers.//: Two years, with subdomains. The static and function paths previously disagreed: 63072000 without includeSubDomains here, 31536000 with it there. helmet is set to match this exactly.
The site asks for none of these, so deny them outright rather than leave the defaults.
headers.value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=()
